verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Retell supports outbound calls, including DTMF navigation on outbound calls. It also offers concurrency-based throughput controls: a default quota of 20 concurrent calls, and reserved inbound concurrency that caps how many concurrent lines outbound calls can use. Nothing in the pack documents a batch campaign feature or call scheduling. Missing for 10: batch/bulk campaign creation (e.g., uploading contact lists), campaign scheduling or calling windows, per-campaign pacing controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
